name: Transient Tool Context
description: Keeps recent tool interactions in bounded process memory and out of persistent OpenClaw session transcripts.

maxInteractions.label: Maximum retained tool interactions
maxInteractions.help: Process-memory ring size. Oldest interactions are discarded first. Default: 200.

maxTransientTokens.label: Maximum transient tool tokens per turn
maxTransientTokens.help: Newest retained interactions are injected until this approximate token budget is reached. Default: 40000.

maxInteractionTokens.label: Maximum tokens per tool interaction
maxInteractionTokens.help: A single carried-forward tool interaction is truncated to this approximate token budget. The live/current tool result is not changed. Default: 2000.

persistToolHistory.label: Persist tool history
persistToolHistory.help: When false, tool-call/result transcript rows are blocked or stripped from persistent session history. Default: false.

dedupeAliases.label: Deduplicate compatibility aliases
dedupeAliases.help: Before any remaining message is written, removes input when identical to arguments and tool-result content when identical to text. Default: true.

injectSameModel.label: Inject same-model tool history
injectSameModel.help: Default false avoids duplicating tool history already held by a warm model thread. Enable for stateless/reconstructed providers that need same-model carry-forward.
